game_concept: A arcade set in The Kingdom – Blacksmith Row, a street of busy forges: the baker's apprentice must handle shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Print Probe: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before shadow scouts act.
theme: The Kingdom – Blacksmith Row: a street of busy forges
core_gameplay_loop: In Blacksmith Row, repeat each round: Use print-style probes to reveal hidden variable values before shadow scouts act. Each round, a new keys challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the shield value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 100 points of keys by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 1 (intro tier): Print Probe
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Probe' (Week 1 slot 13), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Blacksmith Row'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how shield changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow scouts in Blacksmith Row.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 30 seconds.
